sentences.text: Open against closed, three ways: by Epoch's capability index, the best open-weights model (Kimi K3) is about 4 months behind the best closed ones (between 3 and 7 months, given the score's uncertainty); by Arena's blind votes, the best closed model would be preferred to the best open one in about 53% of head-to-head votes, close to a coin flip; by count, 42% of the notable models released in 2025 had downloadable weights. They answer different questions (how capable, how liked, how many), so no single ratio covers all three.

How fast depends on the meter: fitted doubling times run from 3.5 months (Anthropic revenue run-rate) to 3.5 years (Chip speed per dollar (FP16/BF16)); METR's task-length measure doubles about every 4.2 months by its own fit. These count different things, so they are shown side by side, not averaged.

Straight line or bend? Comparing the last 24 months with the years before. Faster lately: Training cost, frontier models. Slower lately: Training compute, all notable models, Nvidia AI compute shipped per quarter, OpenAI revenue run-rate. No clear change: Chip speed per dollar (FP16/BF16). Too few recent points to tell: Training compute, frontier models, All designers' AI compute shipped per quarter, Anthropic revenue run-rate. A bend can be real, or can come from who is counted lately; each chart's coverage note says which labs are missing.
METR's own two task suites disagree: from 2023 on, version 1.1 gives a doubling time of about 4.2 months, version 1.0 about 5.8. Both are shown; neither is averaged away.

Arena's raw votes and its style-adjusted votes put the open-closed gap at 32 and 21 rating points, so the best closed model would win about 55% or 53% of votes against the best open one, depending on the count (both from the 2026-09-13 snapshot). Both are shown.

The newest part of the compute curve leans on whoever discloses: of 120 notable models released since 2025-09-21, 30 have a compute estimate (OpenAI 1 of 24, Alibaba 1 of 12, Google DeepMind 1 of 11, Anthropic 0 of 10, Z.ai (Zhipu AI) 4 of 6).
